name: better-git-commit-message-helper
description: Offline helper that suggests a short Conventional Commits message from your staged changes. Never runs commit, add, reset or push.

commands.title: Suggest Commit Message from Staged Changes

betterCommit.maxHeaderLength.description: Maximum length of the first line (type, scope and subject).

betterCommit.includeScope.description: Suggest a scope such as fix(auth): when it can be inferred confidently.

betterCommit.includeBody.description: Add a short list of the biggest changed files as the commit body.

betterCommit.showStatusBar.description: Show the Commit msg entry in the status bar.

betterCommit.maxDiffSize.description: Maximum number of diff characters analysed. Larger diffs are analysed partly and flagged.
